entity.summary: India-based centralized cryptocurrency exchange providing INR markets, order-book trading, instant buy and sell, systematic purchase tools, OTC, wallet transfers, and mobile access under the Unocoin brand.
entity.notes: Current first-party platform exposes live INR prices, exchange products, order-book support, fees, and account access. Google Play independently shows the Unocoin application updated on May 25, 2026 with more than one million installs and current buy, sell, and trading functionality. Exact launch date and broad regulatory authorization are not asserted in this initial record.

evidence.title: Unocoin official crypto exchange
evidence.notes: Current first-party platform presents live INR-denominated markets, instant buy and sell, exchange access, fees, wallet functions, and account registration under Unocoin Technologies Private Limited.

evidence.title: Unocoin application on Google Play
